title: Concept: Build plugin skipped
description: pom.xml declares a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a plugin whose `skip` configuration is true.
